Class TurRagContextBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.viglet.turing.genai.TurRagContextBuilder
@Component public class TurRagContextBuilder extends Object
Shared builder for RAG infrastructure (EmbeddingModel + VectorStore). Eliminates duplication between SN GenAI, Asset Training, and RAG Search Tool.
Since:
2026.1.14
Author:
